description: This file defines a request class for deleting a catalog item in the Public API of the eShopWeb project. It contains a single property 'CatalogItemId' used to specify which item to delete.

classes.name: DeleteCatalogItemRequest
classes.description: A request object used to delete a catalog item, inherits from BaseRequest and contains the item's identifier.

methods.name: DeleteCatalogItemRequest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the request with the specified catalog item ID.
